title: Reference evaluation
description: One append-only craft-evidence record about a reference (AES-V2.3 / SUE-561). A reference is evaluation context, never a template, and it may never establish a fact — see docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md §2 and editorial/RIGHTS-AND-PROVENANCE.md for the pointer/rights layer this record sits beside. Records are never overwritten; a later opinion is a new record with `supersedes` set.

ref_id.description: Must resolve to an entry in references/catalog.json and matches the pattern used by schemas/editorial-intent.schema.json's reference_input.

modality.description: Which evaluate-reference profile under editorial/profiles/reference/ this record was produced against.

calibration_ref.description: The calibration snapshot active when this evaluation was made (AES-V2.10). Null when no calibration has been activated yet.

profile_ref.description: Repository path of the reference-evaluation profile used.

basis.description: explicit_human_feedback: the human said it. model_inference: an agent judged it. Load-bearing — agent consensus may never silently stand in for human preference.

dimensions.description: Per-dimension craft verdicts. Dimension ids come from the matching modality profile's `dimensions[].id`.

authority_boundary.description: This record grants craft evidence only, never factual authority. A reference may never establish a fact.

supersedes.description: Optional pointer to an earlier evaluation_id this record follows up on. Records are append-only: this never causes the earlier record to be removed or mutated.

verdict.description: do_not_copy: the trait is admired but copying it would be imitation, not a transferable craft lesson.

applicability.description: What this evaluation is cheap to select for later. Ids are the pinned vocabularies in docs/architecture/V2-EDITORIAL-LEARNING-CORE.md.
